title: Agentic BioNeMo: Autonomous Multi-Agent AI Scientist for Target-to-Lead Drug Discovery
description: An autonomous multi-agent artificial intelligence discovery system orchestrating specialized AI agents to generate, filter, dock, and optimize clinical drug candidates against high-priority oncology and viral targets using NVIDIA BioNeMo NIM microservices (MolMIM, DiffDock, ESM-2), RDKit, and automated retrosynthesis.
